claims.candidate_meaning: Speaker refers to an unidentified person as '걔' and says that person was late again (다시).

entailment.reason: The Source lateness assertion is preserved; '또' maps to '다시', and the unidentified referent is a licensed rendering of the unnamed '걔'.

claims.source_meaning: Speaker says the unnamed person '걔' was late again (또).
claims.text: 원문 화자는 정체가 밝혀지지 않은 사람을 '걔'라고 지칭하며, 그 사람이 다시 늦었다고 말했다.

claims.candidate_meaning: Speaker says at the time of the utterance that they are genuinely irritated specifically about the person's lateness again.

entailment.reason: The candidate adds that the irritation targets the lateness ('늦은 일에 대해'); the Source only juxtaposes two adjacent assertions and does not disambiguate the emotional target.

claims.source_meaning: Speaker says 진짜 짜증나 as a separate assertion after the lateness sentence; the Source does not state the emotional target.
claims.text: 원문 화자는 정체가 밝혀지지 않은 사람을 '걔'라고 지칭하며, 그 사람이 다시 늦은 일에 대해 원문 발화 시점에 진짜 짜증난다고 표현했다.
violations: Candidate adds the emotional target '늦은 일에 대해' which is not entailed by the adjacent Source clauses '걔가 또 늦었어. 진짜 짜증나.'
